newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian dlr clears 100 yen barrier to 5-year high.
newsitem.headline: Australian dlr clears 100 yen barrier to 5-year high.

text.p: The Australian dollar breached the one cent to one yen barrier Thursday for the first time since May 1992.

By 4.04 pm (0604 GMT), the Australian dollar had climbed almost a yen on the day to 100.04/14 from 99.15/25 late here on Wednesday. Dealers said it was benefiting from a flow of funds out of the low yielding yen into higher yielding havens like Australia and U.S.
The latest rise brought the dollar's gains this year to eight yen or 8.6 percent and meant it had appreciated by no less than 69 percent since troughing around 59.00 yen in May 1995.
